issue.title: Header-bearing ACE PNG goldens drift since f4d70c452 added the top-bar 'inbox:' label
issue.description:
Found by the sase-171 land agent at master 983965361.

f4d70c452 (feat(ace): labeled dot-separated top-bar indicator cluster, agent 0q9) adds an `inbox:` label to the top-bar indicator cluster, which changes the header row of every header-bearing ACE PNG golden. That commit regenerated only the ~16 indicator-focused goldens it touched, so other goldens now drift at HEAD. Examples verified with `just fix-tui-screenshots --check -- <file>`:
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_plugins.py: 21 of 21 goldens drift.
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_agent_cli_install.py: 6 of 6 drifted; the sase-171 landing refreshed these 6 only.
The diff image is confined to the top-right header cells (the new `inbox:` label and the shifted chips); nothing else changes.

Fix: run a full `just fix-tui-screenshots`, inspect each update group per the tui_screenshot memory note (expect a single top-bar-only group), and commit the refreshed goldens. This is a different root cause from sase-16o and sase-15t.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the --check run reports the same top-bar-only pixel diff on every golden in the file, and the diff matches the label f4d70c452 added; goldens were never regenerated.

payload.description: Separate stale-golden batch with a different root cause; a full fix-tui-screenshots run may refresh both
